title: homalium cochinchinense
intro: Homalium cochinchinense, commonly known as Cochinchinensis Homalium, is a plant species in the family Salicaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Southeast Asian countries, due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and treat various infections. The bioactive constituents of Homalium cochinchinense include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
